feat: load AGENTS.md into the system prompt

A built-in pi-durable extension, pi-action-context, installed after the
coding tools and before the extensions, adds a project_context section like
pi's Project Context block: <agent_dir>/AGENTS.md (when agent_dir is set),
then AGENTS.md or else CLAUDE.md for each directory from the workspace root
down to cwd, never above GITHUB_WORKSPACE. Nested files are listed, not
loaded. The files are read once for each run, so edits during a run don't
update the section (or break the prompt cache).

New inputs: context_files (default true) and context_files_max_bytes
(default 65536). On pull requests from forks, the files come from the base
commit of the pull request.

Refs #53
